name: Banh bo
summary: Bánh bó, as Vietnam Airlines describes it, is roasted glutinous rice milled fine and packed with candied ginger, candied winter melon, peanuts, and sesame.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls a slice soft, lightly sweet, and nutty.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: roast glutinous rice until cooked, mill it fine, and mix in candied ginger, candied winter melon, roasted peanuts, and sesame. Pack it into a long block and slice it thin.
No street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Airlines names no street. It lists the cake as a gift.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000 VND for a 300 g bag.
seoDescription: Bánh bó as Vietnam Airlines describes it, sliced from a packed block, 30,000 VND for 300 g. The hour is Check on arrival.
